**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is planning a birthday party for their niece, Emily, who is 5 years old.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for kid-friendly games and activities suitable for Emily's age group.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of outdoor games including Treasure Hunt, Backyard Obstacle Course, Scavenger Hunt, Bubble Fun, and Red Light, Green Light.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of indoor games including Pinata Time, Simon Says, Freeze Dance, Story Time, and Craft Station.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of other activities including Face Painting, Cake Decorating, Photo Booth, Sensory Play, and Karaoke.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of food and treats including Cupcake Decorating, Finger Foods, Juice Boxes, and Popcorn Bar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised to keep games and activities simple, safe, and age-appropriate for 5-year-olds.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants the party to have a cohesive theme that resonates with Emily's interests.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested several themes including Fairy Garden Party, Pirate's Treasure Hunt Adventure, Outer Space Adventure, Enchanted Forest, Superhero Training Academy, Backyard Camping Adventure, and Princess Party.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided details on how to create a Fairy Door Cake, including design ideas and tips for making tiny door handles and windows.  
[PREFERENCE] User chose the Fairy Door Cake design for the cake.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for making the tiny door handle and windows, including using sugar paste or fondant, creating templates, and attaching them to the cake.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested ideas for the fairy figurine, including creating a sugar fairy, using an edible image, making a candy fairy, using fondant wings, or using a miniature fairy doll.
